A great & timely reminder that #MeToo legislation is currently stalled in Congress — and whomever is elected to #NH01 this fall will likely be asked to vote on it. 
I’d say Sanborn should be asked how he stands on this — but I think I can make a pretty good guess...

On a more serious note now: all the candidates on stage support a woman’s right to choose, transitioning to clean energy by 2050, and would support the congressional #metoo act if elected. #youthvote #lilstatebigvote

We are in the midst of a national reckoning w/ #TimesUp, #MeToo, & #WhyIDidntReport. I don’t doubt these issues that women live everyday will be brought before our courts in some way. Kavanaugh CANNOT be trusted to rule on these issues given his past. We must #WithdrawKavanaugh.

Anyone who tries to cite how recently accusations were brought forward, or past background checks, without acknowledging the context of #MeToo coming to the forefront just LAST YEAR is missing the whole goddamn point. #WithdrawKavanaugh
